policy: The compatibility corpus re-declares schemas instead of importing examples/. Importing an example module runs its top-level code: most schema-bearing examples construct models, print, or exercise drivers at module scope, which would make fixture collection order-dependent and could execute side effects. Every module below is inventoried by AST only (never imported); `schema_bearing`, `models` and `executes_at_import` are re-derived by tests/compatibility/test_fixture_corpus.py and must keep matching this file. `disposition` records whether a schema example was adapted into tests/fixtures/model_performance/models.py or deliberately excluded, with the reason.
